The '''Ruins of Uzer''' are all that remain of the former city of Uzer, an ancient city in the [[Kharidian Desert]] that was destroyed during the [[God Wars]].

==Transportation==

* {{Plink|Necklace of passage}} to the [[Eagle's Eyrie]] — just north-west of the ruins.
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|dlq}} — just south of the ruins, near the [[Desert lizard|desert lizards]].
* {{Plink|Nardah teleport}} — Nardah, south of the ruins.
* {{Plink|Desert amulet 2|txt=Desert amulets}} — Temple of Elidinis in Nardah.
* {{Plink|Pharaoh's sceptre}} — [[Jaleustrophos]] ([[Simon Templeton]]'s camp), well south of the ruins.
* {{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} — [[Pollnivneach]] house portal.

Players can take the magic carpet ride from [[Shantay Pass]] to the ruins after completion of [[The Golem]]. Note that, unlike on the world map, the destination for the ruins of Uzer is simply labeled as "Uzer."

==History==
Uzer was once an advanced civilisation,{{CiteText |text=Varmen's notes |author=Varmen |loc=The Golem |quote=With that information I can say with confidence that these are the ruins of Uzer, an advanced human civilization said to have been destroyed towards the end of the Third Age (roughly 2,500 years ago).}}  inhabited by magical craftsmen who created and used [[golem (race)|golems]]. Based on the carvings in the temple, the citizens of Uzer may have worshipped multiple gods,{{CiteText |text=Varmen's notes |author=Varmen |loc=The Golem |quote=We have also examined the carvings on the large building in the centre. There are symbols depicting several of the ancient gods, including Saradomin, Zamorak, and Armadyl{{nbsp}}...}} but were ultimately aligned with [[Saradomin]].{{CiteText |text=Varmen's notes |author=Varmen |loc=The Golem |quote=It was allied with Saradomin and enjoyed his protection, as well as that of its own mages and warriors.}}

Towards the end of the [[God Wars]], [[Thammaron]], Zamorak's chief lieutenant, opened a portal underneath the temple and bypassed the city's defences. As the city's army was defeated, the people of Uzer starting producing golems to fight off the invading forces,{{CiteText |text=Varmen's notes |author=Varmen |loc=The Golem |quote=...{{nbsp}}its existence tells us that the city's inhabitants were expert magical craftsmen. The huge kilns in some of the buildings indicate that at some point before its destruction the whole city was converted to the manufacture of these golems.}}{{CiteText |text=Varmen's notes |author=Varmen |loc=The Golem |quote=I surmise that the army of golems was created in order to fight the demon, since Uzer's army had been wiped out and Saradomin's forces were increasingly stretched.}} and the golems were able to drive them back, mortally wounding Thammaron who retreated to his throne room.{{CiteNPC|npc=Clay golem|quote=But the demon was badly wounded and elder-demons heal very slowly indeed. It was almost dead when it retreated to its own dimension.|loc=The Golem}} Despite this victory, the weakened city was destroyed not long after by another attack.{{CiteText |text=Varmen's notes |author=Varmen |loc=The Golem |quote=With Saradomin's help the army of Uzer was able to drive Thammaron back, but the record ends at that point and it has always been assumed that a later attack, either by Thammaron or by Zamorak's other forces, finished the city off. }} The survivors likely fled south, to the city of [[Ullek]], before it too was destroyed by Zamorakians under the command of [[Balfrug Kreeyath]].

Later, a group of archaeologists from the [[Varrock Museum]] found the remains of the temple, taking with them one of its statuettes in the process to put in the museum. After finding and repairing a heavily-damaged golem that had remained in the ruins, an adventurer later took the statuette from the museum and returned it to the Uzer temple. The temple was also later [[Shadow of the Storm|used by a group of fanatics to summon a demon]], undoing the efforts of the mage [[Ellemar]] to weaken the demon [[Agrith-Naar]].

== Locations ==
[[File:Uzer underground.png|thumb|The underground portion of the ruins.]]

=== Ruins ===
The ruins of various buildings and kilns are in the vicinity of the temple, the later of which were used to manufacture golems. The last remaining golem and the entrance to the temple are all that remain above the desert sands. It is here that players start [[The Golem]] [[quest]].

===Temple===
Underneath the city lies the temple basement. To the east of the entrance [[black mushroom]]s spawn, while in the north-west one can find a [[strange implement]]. Statues of craftsmen adorn the halls while golem pieces litter the ground. A few ghosts lurk in the hallways. At the far end lies a portal to [[Thammaron's throne room|Thammaron's realm]].
